item.title: Page View
item.description: book table project folder > Solar2D > App Solar2D/main.lua is loaded with editing true, it will show book/page tables. When the simulator is reloaded, it will navigate to the locked page for editing. not locked locked Setting Actually this is a book setting. Name and Orientation are viewed.
